project_scope.note: The Sophora source concept is represented by the accepted canonical Dermatophyllum secundiflorum package; do not create a duplicate species.

recognition.where_to_look_first: Woody evergreen habit plus glossy odd-pinnate leaves; confirm hanging violet-purple pea-flower clusters and thick woody pods.

comparisons.rule: Dermatophyllum is woody and pinnate-leaved; Lupinus is herbaceous and palmately compound.
Dermatophyllum is woody and evergreen; Baptisia is herbaceous.
